eu-ted-tenders-monitor.source: TED Search API v3 (api.ted.europa.eu, EU open data)

uk-company-lookup.source: Companies House official API (company profile + search only, no personal data)
uk-company-lookup.approval: AUTO-APPROVED-PENDING-REVIEW (UK statutory register, company facts only)
uk-company-lookup.pricing_rationale: Highest-demand safe niche (21.7k runs/30d across incumbents); per-lookup pricing beats per-run incumbents on small batches.
uk-company-lookup.notes: Keyless by default: owner's CH key set as secret env var COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY (shared 600 req/5min quota; revisit if volume grows). Customers may bring their own key. Officers/PSC variant still requires owner legal approval (L1).
